title: Grove GMK6450-1 overcomes transport restrictions to dismantle tower crane in the heart of Berlin
summary: German rental company MOBI-HUB deployed Grove's strongest six-axle all-terrain crane to overcome strict transport restrictions and complete heavy lifts on a highly constrained urban jobsite.The GMK6450-1 had its main boom removed for transport compliance, showcasing excellent versatility for a crane of its size.
body_markdown:
At the jobsite, two smaller mobile cranes assisted with positioning the GMK6450-1’s main boom, after which the MOBI-HUB team completed the remaining assembly work. The crane was assembled with a 73 m luffing jib, 115 t of counterweight, and an 8.7 m x 8.5 m outrigger base. This configuration enabled it to efficiently lift and move the heaviest parts of the Potain MD 120 tower crane, which weighed up to 9 t.


The team first removed the major components, including the ballast, counter-jib structure, and main jib sections, before dismantling the mast sections in sequence. Lifts were performed at working radii of up to 72 m and at a hook height of approximately 59 m.


The GMK6450-1 is ideally suited for projects where lifting performance, mobility, and transport efficiency are critical. Its MEGATRAK® independent suspension, all-wheel steering system and compact six-axle design allow it to move efficiently between jobsites. MOBI-HUB also benefits from the local support provided by Manitowoc’s German teams in Wilhelmshaven and Langenfeld, which helps customers maximize uptime and maintain peak performance.


“The GMK6450-1 is a strategic crane in our fleet because it combines transport efficiency, lifting performance and reach in a way that allows us to carry out a wide range of complex projects, and when necessary, we can also meet stringent roading requirements. Its versatility enables us to tackle challenging jobs while delivering the reliability our customers expect,” said Georg Hallau, owner of MOBI-HUB.


The project demonstrates how the GMK6450-1 combines exceptional lifting power with outstanding transport flexibility, enabling customers to tackle complex urban lifting applications efficiently.
